worldcombat.skill.naturepower.summary: Borrow a real move from the environment at release: plants call Energy Ball; water, ice or snow call Hydro Pump; fire or lava call Flamethrower; rock calls Power Gem; other ground calls Tri Attack.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.use.0: Change footing to borrow a different move
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.use.2: Prepare longer to empower this call
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.descriptio: The opening shows the intended move. The actual environment at release selects its full recipe, including contacts, type and secondary effects. Tri Attack on other ground requires a valid enemy.
The call reaches up to %1$s blocks, also limited by the borrowed move. Only Nature Power pays PP and cooldown; the borrowed move keeps its preparation, action and recovery.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.stance.cha: Charged: prepare for %1$s, multiply this call's power by 1.25 and add 2 blocks to the call range cap.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.stance.qui: Quick call: a short preparation, then the borrowed move at its normal power.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.timing: Prepare the call for %1$s s. When the borrowed move commits, pay %2$s Nature Power PP with a %3$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.growth.0: At level %1$s, cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.growth.1: At level %1$s, cooldown drops further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.preference: Prepare about 6 extra ticks for 1.25 times power on this call and 2 extra blocks of call range.
Actively cast within this distance; approach farther targets.
Allow a stationed companion to move for a casting opportunity.
